posts.author: Ebon_Maker5
posts.body:
I'm planning on making a game heavily inspired off fear and hunger and I have an ok idea how many things work in that game (attacking limbs, chance system, ect.) except I have no clue how to replicate one of my favorite parts- the character's battle portraits moving!
I don't know how the dev did it but it's a RAD effect that gives the standard "front view" that RPG maker games have more spice.
What my question is, would be: is there a way I could achieve this for free and not paying for plugins? (Sorry I just don't have the cash to spend on something I might give up on lol)
I already have 1 idea that
is weird...
It would involve having to somehow reposition the sideview battlers to the appropriate spots where the player's UI would be and then making the idle/attack/hurt all sideview animations...
(How I would do that... I don't know lol)
Also yes I know the dev made fear and hunger in RPG Maker MV not MZ, however I like the format of MZ a little more (even if I am shooting myself in the foot a little plug-in wise)
So tldr can I make a battler that shows an animated character waist up above the appropriate UI Spot for free via free plugins or weird methods- Or am I out of luck?
(Don't mean to sound cheap lmao I just know myself to sometimes get mid project and then shelf it)

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body:
The Visustella Core plugins are free, and what you describe here:
Ebon_Maker5 said:
It would involve having to somehow reposition the sideview battlers to the appropriate spots where the player's UI would be and then making the idle/attack/hurt all sideview animations...
Click to expand...
is perfectly doable with Battle Core. It basically involves changing the home position of your battlers, and probably tweaking the step-in animation. There's some more tweaking that's required depending on what kind of animations/motions you want, but best to handle one thing at a time.

hopefully I can get it to work!
